schema.name: audit_events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_events (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 action TEXT NOT NULL, object_type TEXT NOT NULL, object_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 details_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(details_json) AND json_type(details_json)='object'),

)

schema.name: candidate_acquisitions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE candidate_acquisitions (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, acquisition_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 job_candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, batch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 resume_id TEXT, result TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CAPTURED', source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
 captured_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 captured_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,acquisition_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,job_candidate_id,candidate_id)
   REFERENCES job_candidates(org_id,job_id,job_candidate_id,candidate_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,batch_id) REFERENCES scan_batches(org_id,job_id,batch_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,candidate_id,resume_id) REFERENCES resume_snapshots(org_id,candidate_id,resume_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,captured_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id)
)

schema.name: candidate_identity_aliases
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE candidate_identity_aliases (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, external_identity_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 external_identity_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(external_identity_json) AND json_type(external_identity_json)='object'),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,source,external_identity_hash),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,candidate_id) REFERENCES candidates(org_id,candidate_id)
)

schema.name: candidates
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE candidates (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,candidate_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,created_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id)
)

schema.name: data_operations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE data_operations (
 operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, org_id TEXT,
 scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('ORG','INSTANCE')),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('EXPORT','BACKUP','RESTORE','PURGE')),
 actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'REQUESTED'
   CHECK(status IN ('REQUESTED','APPROVED','RUNNING','COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')),
 manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(manifest_json) AND json_type(manifest_json)='object'),
 artifact_ref TEXT, expires_at TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 CHECK((scope='ORG' AND org_id IS NOT NULL) OR (scope='INSTANCE' AND org_id IS NULL)),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES organizations(org_id), FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users(user_id)
)

schema.name: evaluation_attempts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE evaluation_attempts (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(attempt_no)='integer' AND attempt_no>0),
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED')),
 result_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(result_json) AND json_type(result_json)='object'),
 error_type TEXT,
 metrics_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(metrics_json) AND json_type(metrics_json)='object'),
 started_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 completed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,attempt_id), UNIQUE(org_id,task_id,attempt_no),
 UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,task_id,attempt_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,task_id) REFERENCES evaluation_tasks(org_id,job_id,task_id),
 CHECK((status='FAILED' AND error_type IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(error_type))>0) OR
       (status='SUCCEEDED' AND error_type IS NULL))
)

schema.name: evaluation_tasks
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE evaluation_tasks (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 job_candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 policy_id TEXT NOT NULL, policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 resume_id TEXT NOT NULL, execution_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 scoring_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scoring_mode IN ('fast_mode','deep_mode')),
 idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 technical_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK(technical_state IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED')),
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,task_id), UNIQUE(org_id,idempotency_key),
 UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,job_candidate_id,scoring_mode),
 UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,task_id),
 UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,task_id,job_candidate_id,candidate_id,policy_id,policy_version,resume_id,execution_profile_id,scoring_mode),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,job_candidate_id,candidate_id,policy_id,policy_version,resume_id)
   REFERENCES job_candidate_inputs(org_id,job_id,job_candidate_id,candidate_id,policy_id,policy_version,resume_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,policy_id,policy_version,execution_profile_id)
   REFERENCES job_policy_versions(org_id,job_id,policy_id,policy_version,execution_profile_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,created_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id)
)

schema.name: evaluations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE evaluations (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, evaluation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 task_id TEXT NOT NULL, attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 job_candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 policy_id TEXT NOT NULL, policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL, resume_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 execution_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 scoring_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scoring_mode IN ('fast_mode','deep_mode')),
 scoring_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scoring_status IN ('COARSE_ONLY','HARD_FILTERED','DEEP_SCORED')),
 final_score REAL,
 tier0_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(tier0_json) AND json_type(tier0_json)='object'),
 tier1_score REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(tier1_score BETWEEN 0 AND 45),
 tier2_score REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(tier2_score BETWEEN 0 AND 55),
 dimensions_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(dimensions_json) AND json_type(dimensions_json)='object'),
 evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(evidence_json) AND json_type(evidence_json)='array'),
 result_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(result_json) AND json_type(result_json)='object'),
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,evaluation_id), UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,evaluation_id), UNIQUE(org_id,task_id),
 UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,job_candidate_id,scoring_mode),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,task_id,job_candidate_id,candidate_id,policy_id,policy_version,resume_id,execution_profile_id,scoring_mode)
   REFERENCES evaluation_tasks(org_id,job_id,task_id,job_candidate_id,candidate_id,policy_id,policy_version,resume_id,execution_profile_id,scoring_mode),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,task_id,attempt_id)
   REFERENCES evaluation_attempts(org_id,job_id,task_id,attempt_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,created_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id),
 CHECK((scoring_status='DEEP_SCORED' AND scoring_mode='deep_mode' AND final_score IS NOT NULL
         AND typeof(final_score) IN ('real','integer') AND final_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
    OR (scoring_status IN ('COARSE_ONLY','HARD_FILTERED') AND final_score IS NULL))
)

schema.name: execution_profiles
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE execution_profiles (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 profile_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(profile_json) AND json_type(profile_json)='object'),
 profile_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,profile_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,created_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id)
)

schema.name: hr_review_events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE hr_review_events (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, review_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 evaluation_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('APPROVE','REJECT','REQUEST_REVIEW','NOTE')),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,review_event_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,evaluation_id) REFERENCES evaluations(org_id,job_id,evaluation_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,actor_id) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id)
)

schema.name: job_access_grants
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE job_access_grants (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 can_view_resume INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(can_view_resume IN (0,1)),
 can_edit_policy INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(can_edit_policy IN (0,1)),
 can_publish_policy INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(can_publish_policy IN (0,1)),
 can_collect INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(can_collect IN (0,1)),
 can_score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(can_score IN (0,1)),
 can_review INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(can_review IN (0,1)),
 can_export INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(can_export IN (0,1)),
 can_manage_grants INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(can_manage_grants IN (0,1)),
 granted_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 granted_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')), revoked_at TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,job_id,user_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id) REFERENCES jobs(org_id,job_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,user_id) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,granted_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id)
)

schema.name: job_candidate_inputs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE job_candidate_inputs (

 candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, policy_id TEXT NOT NULL, policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 resume_id TEXT NOT NULL, sealed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 sealed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),

)

schema.name: job_candidates
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE job_candidates (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 policy_id TEXT NOT NULL, policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL, first_batch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 first_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,job_id,job_candidate_id),
 UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,candidate_id), UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,candidate_key),
 UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,job_candidate_id,candidate_id),
 UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,job_candidate_id,candidate_id,policy_id,policy_version),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,candidate_id) REFERENCES candidates(org_id,candidate_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,first_batch_id,policy_id,policy_version)
   REFERENCES scan_batches(org_id,job_id,batch_id,policy_id,policy_version)
)

schema.name: job_policy_versions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE job_policy_versions (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, policy_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(policy_version)='integer' AND policy_version>0),
 policy_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(policy_json) AND json_type(policy_json)='object'),
 policy_hash TEXT NOT NULL, original_jd TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', hr_requirements TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 execution_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL, policy_schema_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'storage_snapshot_v1',
 source_draft_id TEXT, draft_revision INTEGER, source_draft_hash TEXT,
 source_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(source_snapshot_json) AND json_type(source_snapshot_json)='object'),
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,job_id,policy_id), UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,policy_version),
 UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,policy_id,policy_version),
 UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,policy_id,policy_version,execution_profile_id),
 CHECK((source_draft_id IS NULL AND draft_revision IS NULL AND source_draft_hash IS NULL) OR
       (source_draft_id IS NOT NULL AND draft_revision IS NOT NULL AND draft_revision>0 AND source_draft_hash IS NOT NULL)),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id) REFERENCES jobs(org_id,job_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,execution_profile_id) REFERENCES execution_profiles(org_id,profile_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,created_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,source_draft_id) REFERENCES policy_drafts(org_id,job_id,draft_id)
)

schema.name: jobs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE jobs (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN' CHECK(state IN ('OPEN','CLOSED')),
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL, current_policy_id TEXT, current_policy_version INTEGER,
 next_policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(typeof(next_policy_version)='integer' AND next_policy_version>0),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,job_id),
 CHECK((current_policy_id IS NULL AND current_policy_version IS NULL) OR
       (current_policy_id IS NOT NULL AND current_policy_version IS NOT NULL)),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,created_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,current_policy_id,current_policy_version)
   REFERENCES policy_publications(org_id,job_id,policy_id,policy_version)
   DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

schema.name: organization_memberships
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE organization_memberships (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 org_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(org_role IN ('ORG_ADMIN','HR')),
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK(state IN ('ACTIVE','DISABLED')),
 joined_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,user_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES organizations(org_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id)
)

schema.name: organizations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE organizations (
 org_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK(state IN ('ACTIVE','DISABLED')),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
)

schema.name: policy_activation_events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE policy_activation_events (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 from_policy_id TEXT, to_policy_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'publish',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,event_id), UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,to_policy_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,from_policy_id) REFERENCES policy_publications(org_id,job_id,policy_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,to_policy_id) REFERENCES policy_publications(org_id,job_id,policy_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,actor_id) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id)
)

schema.name: policy_drafts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE policy_drafts (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, draft_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>0),
 source_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(source_json) AND json_type(source_json)='object'),
 policy_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(policy_json) AND json_type(policy_json)='object'),
 diagnostics_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(diagnostics_json) AND json_type(diagnostics_json)='array'),
 draft_hash TEXT NOT NULL, edited_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,job_id,draft_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id) REFERENCES jobs(org_id,job_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,edited_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id)
)

schema.name: policy_publications
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE policy_publications (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, policy_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL, execution_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 confirmation_hash TEXT NOT NULL, published_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 published_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,job_id,policy_id), UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,policy_id,policy_version),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,policy_id,policy_version,execution_profile_id)
   REFERENCES job_policy_versions(org_id,job_id,policy_id,policy_version,execution_profile_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,published_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id)
)

schema.name: resume_snapshots
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE resume_snapshots (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, resume_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 raw_resume_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(raw_resume_json) AND json_type(raw_resume_json)='object'),
 normalized_resume_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(normalized_resume_json) AND json_type(normalized_resume_json)='object'),
 content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, raw_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 completeness TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(completeness IN ('COMPLETE','PARTIAL','COLLECTION_FAILED')),
 is_scorable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(is_scorable IN (0,1)),
 collection_errors_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(collection_errors_json) AND json_type(collection_errors_json)='array'),
 data_issues_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(data_issues_json) AND json_type(data_issues_json)='array'),
 mapper_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'resume-v2', captured_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 captured_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 retention_version_id TEXT, expires_at TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,candidate_id,resume_id), UNIQUE(org_id,candidate_id,raw_hash),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,candidate_id) REFERENCES candidates(org_id,candidate_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,captured_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,retention_version_id) REFERENCES retention_policy_versions(org_id,retention_version_id),
 CHECK(is_scorable=0 OR (completeness='COMPLETE' AND json_array_length(collection_errors_json)=0 AND json_array_length(data_issues_json)=0))
)

schema.name: retention_policy_versions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE retention_policy_versions (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, retention_version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 rules_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(rules_json) AND json_type(rules_json)='object'),
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,retention_version_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,created_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id)
)

schema.name: scan_batches
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE scan_batches (
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, batch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 policy_id TEXT NOT NULL, policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RUNNING' CHECK(status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSED','COMPLETED','CANCELLED')),
 started_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')), completed_at TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(org_id,job_id,batch_id),
 UNIQUE(org_id,job_id,batch_id,policy_id,policy_version),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id) REFERENCES jobs(org_id,job_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,job_id,policy_id,policy_version) REFERENCES policy_publications(org_id,job_id,policy_id,policy_version),
 FOREIGN KEY(org_id,created_by) REFERENCES organization_memberships(org_id,user_id),
 CHECK((status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSED') AND completed_at IS NULL) OR
       (status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL))
)

schema.name: schema_migrations
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,checksum TEXT NOT NULL, schema_hash TEXT NOT NULL,applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

schema.name: users
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
 user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, auth_subject TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK(state IN ('ACTIVE','DISABLED')),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))

schema.name: acquisition_running_batch
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER acquisition_running_batch BEFORE INSERT ON candidate_acquisitions
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scan_batches b JOIN jobs j USING(org_id,job_id)
 WHERE b.org_id=NEW.org_id AND b.job_id=NEW.job_id AND b.batch_id=NEW.batch_id
 AND b.status='RUNNING' AND j.state='OPEN')
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'acquisition requires a running batch in the same job'); END

schema.name: association_matches_batch
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER association_matches_batch BEFORE INSERT ON job_candidates
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scan_batches b JOIN jobs j USING(org_id,job_id)
 WHERE b.org_id=NEW.org_id AND b.job_id=NEW.job_id AND b.batch_id=NEW.first_batch_id
 AND b.policy_id=NEW.policy_id AND b.policy_version=NEW.policy_version
 AND b.status='RUNNING' AND j.state='OPEN')
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'new candidate must bind its running first batch policy'); END

schema.name: attempt_running_task
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER attempt_running_task BEFORE INSERT ON evaluation_attempts
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_tasks t WHERE t.org_id=NEW.org_id
 AND t.job_id=NEW.job_id AND t.task_id=NEW.task_id AND t.technical_state='RUNNING')
 OR NEW.attempt_no<>COALESCE((SELECT MAX(attempt_no)+1 FROM evaluation_attempts
   WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND task_id=NEW.task_id),1)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'attempt requires a running task and sequential attempt number'); END

schema.name: batch_creator_permission
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER batch_creator_permission BEFORE INSERT ON scan_batches
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organization_memberships m JOIN users u USING(user_id)
 JOIN organizations o USING(org_id) WHERE m.org_id=NEW.org_id AND m.user_id=NEW.created_by
 AND m.state='ACTIVE' AND u.state='ACTIVE' AND o.state='ACTIVE'
 AND (m.org_role='ORG_ADMIN' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_access_grants g
  WHERE g.org_id=NEW.org_id AND g.job_id=NEW.job_id AND g.user_id=NEW.created_by
  AND g.can_collect=1 AND g.revoked_at IS NULL)))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'batch creator lacks collection permission'); END

schema.name: batch_lifecycle
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER batch_lifecycle BEFORE UPDATE ON scan_batches
WHEN NOT ((NEW.status=OLD.status)
 OR (OLD.status='RUNNING' AND NEW.status IN ('PAUSED','COMPLETED','CANCELLED'))
 OR (OLD.status='PAUSED' AND NEW.status IN ('RUNNING','COMPLETED','CANCELLED')))
 OR (OLD.status IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') AND NEW.completed_at IS NOT OLD.completed_at)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'illegal scan batch lifecycle'); END

schema.name: batch_lock_current
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER batch_lock_current BEFORE INSERT ON scan_batches
WHEN NEW.status<>'RUNNING' OR NEW.completed_at IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND job_id=NEW.job_id AND state='OPEN'
 AND current_policy_id=NEW.policy_id AND current_policy_version=NEW.policy_version)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'new batch must lock the current published policy'); END

schema.name: evaluation_accepted_attempt
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER evaluation_accepted_attempt BEFORE INSERT ON evaluations
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_attempts a JOIN evaluation_tasks t
 ON a.org_id=t.org_id AND a.job_id=t.job_id AND a.task_id=t.task_id
 WHERE a.org_id=NEW.org_id AND a.job_id=NEW.job_id AND a.task_id=NEW.task_id
 AND a.attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id AND a.status='SUCCEEDED' AND t.technical_state='SUCCEEDED'
 AND json(a.result_json)=json(NEW.result_json))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'formal result requires the matching successful completed attempt'); END

schema.name: evaluation_payload_matches_columns
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER evaluation_payload_matches_columns BEFORE INSERT ON evaluations
WHEN json_extract(NEW.result_json,'$.candidate_key') IS NOT
 (SELECT candidate_key FROM job_candidates WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND job_id=NEW.job_id AND job_candidate_id=NEW.job_candidate_id)
 OR json_extract(NEW.result_json,'$.scoring_mode') IS NOT NEW.scoring_mode
 OR json_extract(NEW.result_json,'$.scoring_status') IS NOT NEW.scoring_status
 OR json_extract(NEW.result_json,'$.total_score') IS NOT NEW.final_score
 OR json_extract(NEW.result_json,'$.debug_trace.tier1_capped_score') IS NOT NEW.tier1_score
 OR json_extract(NEW.result_json,'$.debug_trace.tier2_semantic_score') IS NOT NEW.tier2_score
 OR json_extract(NEW.result_json,'$.dimension_scores') IS NOT json(NEW.dimensions_json)
 OR json_extract(NEW.result_json,'$.evidence_details') IS NOT json(NEW.evidence_json)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'formal result JSON does not match its relational columns'); END

CREATE TRIGGER policy_activated AFTER INSERT ON policy_publications
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO policy_activation_events(org_id,job_id,event_id,from_policy_id,to_policy_id,actor_id)
 SELECT NEW.org_id,NEW.job_id,lower(hex(randomblob(16))),current_policy_id,NEW.policy_id,NEW.published_by
 FROM jobs WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND job_id=NEW.job_id;
 UPDATE jobs SET current_policy_id=NEW.policy_id,current_policy_version=NEW.policy_version
 WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND job_id=NEW.job_id;
END

schema.name: policy_draft_revision
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER policy_draft_revision BEFORE UPDATE ON policy_drafts
WHEN NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'draft update requires the next revision'); END

schema.name: policy_pointer_forward
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER policy_pointer_forward BEFORE UPDATE OF current_policy_id,current_policy_version ON jobs
WHEN (NEW.current_policy_id IS NOT OLD.current_policy_id OR NEW.current_policy_version IS NOT OLD.current_policy_version)
 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM policy_publications p WHERE p.org_id=NEW.org_id AND p.job_id=NEW.job_id
   AND p.policy_id=NEW.current_policy_id AND p.policy_version=NEW.current_policy_version)
 OR (OLD.current_policy_version IS NOT NULL AND NEW.current_policy_version<=OLD.current_policy_version))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'current policy requires a forward published version'); END

schema.name: policy_publication_gate
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER policy_publication_gate BEFORE INSERT ON policy_publications
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_policy_versions v JOIN jobs j USING(org_id,job_id)
 WHERE v.org_id=NEW.org_id AND v.job_id=NEW.job_id AND v.policy_id=NEW.policy_id
 AND v.policy_version=NEW.policy_version AND v.execution_profile_id=NEW.execution_profile_id
 AND ((v.source_draft_id IS NULL AND v.policy_hash=NEW.confirmation_hash)
   OR (v.source_draft_id IS NOT NULL AND v.source_draft_hash=NEW.confirmation_hash))
 AND j.state='OPEN'
 AND (j.current_policy_version IS NULL OR NEW.policy_version>j.current_policy_version)
 AND (v.source_draft_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM policy_drafts d
   WHERE d.org_id=v.org_id AND d.job_id=v.job_id AND d.draft_id=v.source_draft_id
   AND d.revision=v.draft_revision AND d.draft_hash=v.source_draft_hash
   AND d.policy_json=v.policy_json AND d.source_json=v.source_snapshot_json
   AND json_array_length(d.diagnostics_json)=0)))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'publication requires matching confirmed policy and current draft'); END

schema.name: policy_publication_permission
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER policy_publication_permission BEFORE INSERT ON policy_publications
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organization_memberships m JOIN users u USING(user_id)
 JOIN organizations o USING(org_id) WHERE m.org_id=NEW.org_id AND m.user_id=NEW.published_by
 AND m.state='ACTIVE' AND u.state='ACTIVE' AND o.state='ACTIVE'
 AND (m.org_role='ORG_ADMIN' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_access_grants g
   WHERE g.org_id=NEW.org_id AND g.job_id=NEW.job_id AND g.user_id=NEW.published_by
   AND g.can_publish_policy=1 AND g.revoked_at IS NULL)))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'publisher lacks active publication permission'); END

schema.name: policy_version_allocated
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER policy_version_allocated AFTER INSERT ON job_policy_versions
BEGIN UPDATE jobs SET next_policy_version=NEW.policy_version+1
 WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND job_id=NEW.job_id; END

schema.name: policy_version_sequence
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER policy_version_sequence BEFORE INSERT ON job_policy_versions
WHEN NEW.policy_version <> COALESCE((SELECT MAX(policy_version)+1 FROM job_policy_versions
 WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND job_id=NEW.job_id),1)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'policy version must advance by one within its job'); END

schema.name: seal_complete_acquired_resume
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER seal_complete_acquired_resume BEFORE INSERT ON job_candidate_inputs
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resume_snapshots r WHERE r.org_id=NEW.org_id
 AND r.candidate_id=NEW.candidate_id AND r.resume_id=NEW.resume_id
 AND r.completeness='COMPLETE' AND r.is_scorable=1
 AND json_array_length(r.collection_errors_json)=0 AND json_array_length(r.data_issues_json)=0)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM candidate_acquisitions a WHERE a.org_id=NEW.org_id
 AND a.job_id=NEW.job_id AND a.job_candidate_id=NEW.job_candidate_id
 AND a.candidate_id=NEW.candidate_id AND a.resume_id=NEW.resume_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'input requires a complete scorable resume acquired for this candidate/job'); END

schema.name: task_initial_state
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER task_initial_state BEFORE INSERT ON evaluation_tasks
WHEN NEW.technical_state<>'PENDING'
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'evaluation task must start pending'); END

schema.name: task_lifecycle
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER task_lifecycle BEFORE UPDATE OF technical_state ON evaluation_tasks
WHEN NOT (NEW.technical_state=OLD.technical_state
 OR (OLD.technical_state IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND NEW.technical_state='RUNNING')
 OR (OLD.technical_state='RUNNING' AND NEW.technical_state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED')))
 OR (NEW.technical_state='SUCCEEDED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_attempts
   WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND task_id=NEW.task_id AND status='SUCCEEDED'))
 OR (NEW.technical_state='FAILED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_attempts
   WHERE org_id=NEW.org_id AND task_id=NEW.task_id AND status='FAILED'))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'illegal evaluation task state or missing completed attempt'); END
